title: Consumer Compass Repeatability Observation — Interest Review
summary: Current administrative record for the Consumer Compass Repeatability Observation interest screen and stationary-reading protocol.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD
sections.body:
**Study reference:** ST-26-027

**Protocol revision:** 1.0

**Responsible unit:** Participant Programs Office

**Administrative state:** Interest screening

**Effective date:** 2026-08-11

**Personnel record:** Role-only working copy

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Objective:** Maintain a limited public interest screen for a stationary consumer-compass observation method conducted on nonconsecutive days.

**Scope limitation:** Interest screening does not enroll a participant. No precise location, travel pattern, device identifier, photograph, or individual reading is received through this network.

sections.title: METHOD & OBSERVATIONS
sections.body:
**Administrative review:** Confirmed the fixed-position instruction, five-reading sequence, nonconsecutive-day schedule, and broad equipment categories.

**Observation:** The public screen establishes only general equipment and schedule suitability. It does not request coordinates or motion data.

sections.title: DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Disposition:** Retain interest-screening status while the participation schedule is evaluated.

**Next review:** Confirm the fixed-position instructions before a recruiting revision is considered.

**Review status:** Interest materials approved for public display.
